subject: general
question: A person walks 825 m in 3 minutes. What is his speed in km/h?
solution:
Given:

The person walks 825 m in 3 minutes.

Concept used:

1m/s = 18/5 km/h

Time × Speed = Distance

Calculation:

3 minutes = 180 seconds

According to the concept, his speed

⇒ 825 ÷ 180

⇒ 55/12 m/s

⇒ (55/12 × 18/5) km/h

⇒ 33/2 km/h

⇒ 16.5 km/h

∴ His speed is 16.5 km/h.
